headlines.title: FTSE falls despite US debt deal, with BAE Systems lower after downgrade
US credit rating downgraded to AA+ by Standard & Poor's
S.& P. Downgrades Debt Rating of U.S. for the First Time
headlines.abstract: Standard & Poor’s removed the United States government from its list of risk-free borrowers, dropping the rating on concerns about federal debt.

headlines.title: US attacks S&P's 'credibility and integrity' over debt downgrade
S.&P. Downgrade Is Seen as Adding Urgency to Debt-Cutting Panel
headlines.abstract: Credit rating is almost sure to increase pressure on a new Congressional panel to recommend a package of deficit-reduction measures.
